title: Konami Antiques: MSX Collection Ultra Pack
native_title: コナミ・アンティークス ＭＳＸコレクション・ウルトラ・パック
overview:
This collection of Konami MSX games bundles the three previous PlayStation releases in the series. The full list of 30 games includes:

• Athletic Land
• Antarctic Adventure
• Comic Bakery
• Gofer no yabō: Episode II
• Gradius
• Gradius 2
• Hyper Sports II
• Hyper Sports III
• Knightmare
• King's Valley
• Konami's Boxing
• Konami's Golf
• Konami Rally
• Konami's Soccer
• Konami's Tennis
• Magical Tree
• Mopiranger
• Parodius
• Penguin Adventure
• Ping-Pong
• Pippols
• Road Fighter
• Salamander
• Sky Jaguar
• Super Cobra
• Time Pilot
• Twin Bee
• Yie Ar Kung-Fu
• Yie Ar Kung-Fu 2: The Emperor Yie-Gah
